summary: Iteration 21 CSS fix for .auth-slider verified on RoleSelect '/'. Slider is now flush to top (top=0) and full width of container on both mobile (375) and desktop (1440). All top/bottom border-radius = 0. Backend /api/settings/public unchanged and returns 2 loaded slides with autoplay=true. Slider functionality (dots + swipe transform) preserved.
critical_code_review_comments: CSS fix in /app/frontend/src/index.css .auth-slider is minimal and correct: width:calc(100% + 3rem) with margin:-1.5rem -1.5rem 1.5rem cancels parent p-6 padding on 4 sides (top+left+right) while keeping 1.5rem bottom margin below the slider — visually flush to top and full-bleed horizontally.
Removed @media(min-width:768px) block that previously applied border-radius:20px + margin:0 on desktop; now desktop is also flush and radius-free as intended.

Note: RoleSelect background gets a red tint in screenshots — this is unrelated to the slider fix (map-background likely relies on an external image not loaded in test env); the slider itself renders correctly with the bear photos. No action needed for this iteration.
